meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析、比较与注释进化树
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果处理系统发育数据并需要比较树结构。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze, compare, and annotate phylogenetic trees.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with phylogenetic data and need to compare tree topologies.

howto.what: 技能装好后，Claude 能用 ETE 读取、修改和比较进化树文件，识别基因复制/分化事件，查询 NCBI 分类信息，并把树渲染成 PDF、SVG 等图。
howto.when: 当用户请求分析、修改或可视化进化树，比较两棵树，处理 Newick/Nexus 文件，或查询 NCBI 分类时触发；不用于从原始序列直接推断树。

say.text: 读取 tree.nw，给出叶子数和节点数统计。
say.note: 返回树的基本统计信息。

say.text: 把 gene_tree.nw 用 NCBI 分类注释叶节点。
say.note: 首次使用会自动下载 NCBI 分类库（约 300MB）。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read, modify, and compare phylogenetic tree files, identify duplication/speciation events, query NCBI taxonomy, and render trees to PDF or SVG images.
howto.when_en: Triggered by requests to read, edit, visualize, or compare phylogenetic trees, handle Newick/Nexus files, or query NCBI taxonomy; not for inferring trees from raw sequences.

say_en.text: Read tree.nw and show its leaf and node counts.
Compute the Robinson-Foulds distance between tree1.nw and tree2.nw.
say_en.note: Gives a measure of topological difference.

say_en.text: Annotate gene_tree.nw leaves with NCBI taxonomy.
say_en.note: First use downloads NCBI taxonomy DB (~300MB).
